name: History Lab
tagline: Replay history — and fact-check the AI to win.
short_description: A branching, illustrated historical decision game where catching the AI's hallucinations is the core mechanic.
description: Step into a pivotal historical moment (the Cuban Missile Crisis, and more). Anna's host agent streams a grounded scene and three plausible choices, and generates period art. Before the timeline can advance, it proposes a 'Historian's Ruling' — and you, the reviewing historian, must Approve it or Flag it as a hallucination. Only approved rulings commit to durable state and advance the canonical timeline, while your fact-checking accuracy updates live. At the end, your illustrated decision-storybook is posted back into the chat. AI generates, the human ratifies, Anna remembers.
